subject: Reconcile Evernorth convertible-note cash after advisor fee and distinguish the $9.7M Company Facility from Evernorth's separate $1M facility

repository_context.note: SEC filing inspected as rendered HTML; no byte-complete source capture or independently anchored retrieval timestamp is claimed.

source_registry.source_type: SEC Form S-1 registration statement; preliminary prospectus subject to completion

narrative_disclosure.basis: Net proceeds before transaction expenses payable by Pubco.
narrative_disclosure.intended_use: General corporate purposes, including acquisition of XRP and other XRP ecosystem activities.

financial_statement_note.basis: Net cash proceeds after deducting the $1.0M capital-markets-advisor fee.

convertible_note_reconciliation.interpretation: The $30.0M narrative amount is before transaction expenses; the financial-statement note reports $29.0M cash after the $1.0M advisor fee. Do not describe $30.0M as cash available after the advisor fee.

company_facility_with_ripple.scope: Includes amounts Ripple paid to third parties on behalf of the Company and Evernorth that were treated as borrowings under the Company Facility Agreement.
company_facility_with_ripple.repayment_due: Within five business days after the Closing Date or earlier after five business days' notice of demand by Ripple.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The S-1 contains two note-proceeds figures.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The narrative reports $30.0M net before transaction expenses; the financial-statement note reports $29.0M cash after a $1.0M advisor fee.
competing_interpretations.counterevidence: Subsequent filings are still required to establish final cash available after all transaction expenses and any actual XRP purchases funded by the notes.

competing_interpretations.hypothesis: The $9.7M and $1.0M facilities are the same borrowing.
competing_interpretations.evidence: The $9.7M draw is under the $10M Company Facility; Evernorth has a separate $1M revolving Evernorth Facility and had borrowed zero as of June 30, 2026.
competing_interpretations.counterevidence: The Company Facility includes payments made on behalf of both the Company and Evernorth, so its full $9.7M is not necessarily Evernorth-specific funding.

red_team_objections: Do not describe the $30M note amount as cash after the $1M advisor fee; the filing separately reports $29M after that fee.
Do not treat the $30M note proceeds as equity capital or as an actual XRP purchase.
Do not attribute the $9.7M Company Facility draw entirely to Evernorth.
Do not conflate the $9.7M Company Facility with the separate $1M Evernorth Facility.
Do not assume the $9.7M Company Facility has been repaid; the prospectus does not verify repayment.
Do not treat the $214.1M historical cash-funded XRP purchase from November 2025 as a November 2026 spot-market flow.

reasons: SEC disclosure is a corporate financing and balance-sheet record, not an XRP market-flow feature.
The filing was inspected as rendered HTML without byte-complete raw-source receipt.
Actual XRP purchases funded by convertible-note proceeds are not disclosed.
Repayment of the $9.7M Company Facility is not verified.

forecast.reason: Debt proceeds, financing capacity and historical XRP purchases do not establish a validated directional XRP signal.

next_actions: Monitor subsequent SEC filings for actual XRP acquisitions funded by the convertible notes.
Verify the $9.7M Company Facility repayment and distinguish it from Evernorth's separate $1M facility.
Keep note principal, cash after fees, in-kind XRP, historical cash purchases, contingent ELOC capacity and debt balances in separate ledgers.
